title: 1. The Problem: 4 Hours vs 10 Seconds
items: 40-row export: 20 country variants (US, USA, United States...)
4 hours of VLOOKUPs vs 10 seconds of code
narration: Here's the problem. A 40-row customer export with 20 country variants — US, USA, United States, U.S.A. — all meaning the same thing. Mixed date formats: ISO, slash-separated, dashes for missing. Spend columns with 1250.50, 890.00, then dashes and N/A that people mistakenly zero out, corrupting financial totals. And 20 duplicate customer IDs silently inflating your metrics. Four hours of VLOOKUPs and manual fixes, or ten seconds of code.
caption: Messy data: country variants, mixed dates, dirty numbers, silent duplicates

title: 2. The 3-Tier Pipeline Architecture
items: PARSE: Load raw, detect dtypes, flag anomalies
NORMALIZE: LLM-assisted category mapping (20 to 6 canonical)
VALIDATE: Pandas schema guards, verification log, human review
narration: The solution is a three-tier pipeline. Parse: load the raw file, detect data types, flag anomalies. Normalize: use LLM-assisted category mapping — twenty country variants collapse to six canonical names. Validate: Pandas schema guards and a verification log that a human reviews before the data hits production.
caption: Inspect to Fix to Verify: three stages, zero manual cleanup

title: 3. Step 1: Duplicate Audit
narration: Step one: duplicate audit. We flag every row sharing a customer_id, count them, then drop duplicates keeping the first occurrence. Twenty duplicate rows removed instantly.
caption: Duplicate audit: flag to count to drop keeping first

title: 4. Step 2: Spend Cleanup (Never Zero Financials!)
narration: Step two: spend cleanup. This is critical — never zero out financial nulls. Replace dashes and N/A with NaN, then coerce to numeric. Seven dashes become NaN, preserved for human review, not silently zeroed.
caption: Guardrail: NaN for missing financials, never zero

title: 5. Step 3: Mixed Date Parsing
narration: Step three: mixed date parsing. Pandas 3.x format='mixed' handles ISO, slash-separated, and missing values in one call. Twenty mixed dates parsed to ISO format automatically.
caption: One call parses ISO, slashes, and missing values

title: 6. Step 4: Country Normalization
narration: Step four: country normalization. A simple mapping dictionary — twenty variants map to six canonical names. Unmatched values are preserved for review, not dropped.
caption: 20 country variants map to 6 canonical names

title: 7. Edge Cases and Hallucination Guards
items: Pydantic or JSON Schema validation on output
Never zero financial nulls to keep NaN
Preserve unmatched categories for human review
narration: Edge cases and hallucination guards. Pydantic or JSON Schema validation on output. Never zero financial nulls — keep them as NaN. Preserve unmatched categories for human review. Generate a structured Markdown cleaning log. Row-count sanity checks ensure you didn't lose half your data. Human-in-the-loop equals production safety.
caption: Production safety: validate, preserve, log, sanity-check

title: 8. Results and Verification
items: Verification log and schema guards passed
narration: The results: forty rows become twenty clean rows. Twenty duplicate IDs removed. Seven spend dashes become NaN, not zero. Twenty mixed dates parsed to ISO format. Twenty country variants collapse to six canonical. Twenty phones normalized to E.164. A full verification log generated. All five schema guards passed. Ready for next month's batch.
caption: Verified clean: 20 rows, 5 schema checks passed
